name: BAT_ST_PERCHED
meaning: SetState 0: anim STAND at homePos; Update: takes off (1) when the target is within 800 units (inferred)

name: BAT_ST_APPROACH
meaning: SetState 1: anim FLY + flap sound 0xfe; Update: flies toward the target, circles (2) inside approachRadius, returns (3) beyond 1000 (inferred)

name: BAT_ST_CIRCLE
meaning: SetState 2: anim FLY, orbit set up; Update: orbits until circleTimeMs runs out, then 3 (inferred)

name: BAT_ST_RETURN
meaning: SetState 3: anim FLY2; Update: on anim end -> 0 (inferred)
